items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: Had me, Buck Johnson, George Lewis, Abby Williams, and Baby Dot.

ctx.x: I never heard anything like that myself lately.

Oh yeah, well, that was the good old days. A whole lot of the good old days things you know I have now. And I played on the bandwagon. You heard about the bandwagon? Well, I played on the bandwagon with Buck Johnson. Had me, Buck Johnson, George Lewis, Abby Williams, and Baby Dot. Baby Dot played auditorium that night and we played the advertising with Buck that day.
Oh yes, I think I heard about it back in the 1940s.
